name: Explicit N=1 cubic-symmetry shell-energy alias beyond translations

statement.latest: \exists x_a,x_b\in X_1:\;x_b\notin\mathbb T^3\!\cdot x_a,\quad I^{(n)}(x_a)=I^{(n)}(x_b)\text{ for every arbitrary finite }n
statement.note_ascii: one-mode states supported at (1,0,0) and (0,1,0), related by a cubic axis swap but not by translation, have identical shell-energy derivative records; for each finite n the equality follows from the one-mode formula I^(n)=(-2 nu)^n I

definitions.X_1: fixed finite N=1 incompressible Fourier-Galerkin state space
definitions.translation_orbit: spatial translations alter Fourier phases but preserve wavevector support

parents.evidence: local quotient completeness modulo continuous translations does not exclude discrete global aliases

claim_boundary: Fixed finite N=1 explicit alias. It refutes global uniqueness modulo translations for shell-energy-only observations, but does not classify every discrete symmetry or every possible non-symmetry alias at arbitrary finite N.
honest_caveats: The N=1 truncated single-mode closed-form decay law I^(n)(x) = (-2*nu*kappa(wv x))^n * E0(x) is taken as a definition in the Coq file (it is the direct algebraic consequence of dE/dt = -2*nu*kappa*E, which this proposal's how_to_check derives in prose from the Galerkin-truncation annihilation of the single axis-aligned unit mode's quadratic self-term); the Navier-Stokes/Galerkin-projection argument establishing that this closed form is the TRUE truncated-dynamics solution is not itself mechanized here. The translation-orbit non-membership is proved from the single abstract hypothesis the proposal's own argument actually uses (a translation preserves wavevector support), over an arbitrary group action G, not from a constructed torus-translation action. Both the kappa-equality ((1,0,0) and (0,1,0) both have |k|^2=1) and the wavevector inequality are exact finite arithmetic, checked by computation/discriminate.
